brief: Draw a block figure titled "Telemetry export pipeline" for an internal monitoring stack. A poller collects raw samples from a device on a timer. A normalizer reshapes the raw samples into a common schema. A separate health probe independently pings the device and feeds its status into the same normalizer. Once normalized, samples pass into a ring buffer that holds them briefly, and an exporter drains the buffer and ships samples to a remote collector. Use these ids for the five components: poller, normalizer, healthprobe, buffer, exporter. Show the four connections the description implies: poller into the normalizer, the health probe into the normalizer, the normalizer into the buffer, and the buffer into the exporter.
